entries.name: Inferno Blast
entries.hint: Double Ember fire power creates lasting scorched earth.
entries.lore: The concentrated essence of twin embers burns so intensely it leaves flaming puddles on the ground.

entries.name: Glacier Chill
entries.hint: Freeze foes solid, then stomp them with Shockwave!
entries.lore: Cryo-crystallized frost entombs enemies in solid rime. A subsequent kinetic shock shatters them into frozen dust.

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.hint: Twin sparks leap between multiple targets.
entries.lore: Superconducting discharge that cascades across the air, bridging targets in a split-second electrical web.

entries.name: Steam Burst
entries.hint: Fire meets ice to obscure enemy vision.
entries.lore: Thermal equilibrium violently disrupts moisture into a blinding cloud of boiling vapor.

entries.name: Plasma Orb
entries.hint: Electrified fire pierces straight through lines of enemies.
entries.lore: Magnetically focused ball lightning superheated into ionizing fourth-state matter.

entries.name: Shatter Shot
entries.hint: Ice and lightning fracture into a 5-way spread.
entries.lore: Brittle frost crystals charged with static charge fracture into a razor-sharp conical spray.

entries.name: Firestorm Slam
entries.hint: Leap slam while carrying Ember fire in your belly.
entries.lore: Tode crashes down with meteor force, sending a shock ring of liquid fire across the garden.

entries.name: Blizzard Slam
entries.hint: Leap slam while carrying Frost ice in your belly.
entries.lore: Impact creates a slippery permafrost shockwave that flash-freezes all surrounding foes.

entries.name: Tempest Slam
entries.hint: Leap slam while carrying Spark lightning in your belly.
entries.lore: Tode's impact summons a localized electrical storm, striking down multiple invaders from the sky.
